newsitem.title: USA: ADR REPORT - ADRs rise slightly in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: ADR REPORT - ADRs rise slightly in quiet trade.

text.p: American Depositary Receipts (ADRs) rose slightly in quiet featureless trade Friday, traders said.
They said European shares were generally weaker because of a strengthening dollar.
"There is really nothing special today, either in countries or in companies," a trader said.
Advancers led decliners 241 to 226 among 814 ADRs and foreign shares. The ADR group was up 0.05 percent in late morning, and volume was 25 million ADRs.
Canada's Gandalf Technologies Inc was off 5/16 to 11/16 on volume of one million shares. The stock was the most active among foreign shares and ADRs on the New York Exchanges.
Among other active shares, Brazil's Telebras SA was up 1-5/8 to 157 and Mexico's Telefonos de Mexico rose 1/16 to 48-5/16.
Mexico's Coca-Cola FEMSA also was up 4-1/8 to 55-5/8, above a 12-month high, in moderate volume.
Sweden's Telefon AB L.M. Ericsson was up 2/16 to 40-9/16.
ADRs allow U.S. trade of foreign shares.
